headline: Pentagon data breach exposes records of millions of personnel
summary: Hackers breached US Department of Defense systems in a months-long intrusion, exposing personal data on millions of current and former military and civilian personnel. The Pentagon says it has secured the source of the leak.

claims.statement: Hackers breached US Department of Defense systems, exposing personal data on millions of military and civilian personnel.

sources.quote: Pentagon gets pwned as breach exposes sensitive data on nearly three million military and civilian personnel
Hackers stole millions of US military personnel records during months-long data breach

claims.statement: The Pentagon said the source of the breach has already been secured.

sources.quote: The Pentagon says that it has already secured the source of the leak

claims.statement: The breach occurred over a period of months.
Tom's Hardware reports the breach affected nearly three million personnel.

sources.quote: nearly three million military and civilian personnel
